pages.text: A thick wooden post stood beside the walkway. Rising water covered the wooden path.
Holding Ddori's hand, Bung looked at the snack boat. "I will buy you something crunchy!" Mom gave two coins.
Bung bought a rustling bag of snacks.
A puppy barked nearby. Bung set the bag on the walkway and went to it.
Bung stroked the puppy's back. Beside Bung, Ddori copied.
The water rose gently. The walkway went underwater.
Grandpa lifted the bag with a long stick. The snacks were soggy, no good to eat.
He touched the wet post. "The water rises this high."
Next day, Bung bought snacks and immediately put them high inside the boat.
Rising water covered the walkway again. But the snacks stayed crunchy. The two shared them, one each.
